data.title: 2026-08-28 — Meeting w/ Kay (G&B)
data.content_plaintext:
Summary:
LOI walkthrough on Brooke / Sidney Garber.
Main open issue is inventory valuation, working capital, and closing mechanics.
Brooke is reviewing with her husband and will reconnect next week.
Key takeaways:
Seller note and rollover are doing trust-work in the structure.
Inventory transfer and valuation method are the diligence bottleneck.
Year-end report / operating artifacts are useful and should be reused.
